Account Executive, SaaS Platform

London / remote-friendly · Full time

Northwind builds a workflow automation platform used by operations teams at mid-market companies. We are growing the commercial team and looking for an Account Executive to own the full sales cycle for new business across EMEA.

What you will do

  • Run the full cycle: prospecting, discovery, technical demo, security review, pricing and close. Deal sizes are typically £15k–£60k ARR.
  • Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's stack, and translate technical capability into operational and commercial outcomes.
  • Partner with solutions engineering on integration scoping, onboarding plans and proofs of concept.
  • Manage pipeline hygiene in HubSpot, forecast accurately, and work multi-threaded deals across IT, operations and finance stakeholders.
  • Feed customer requirements back to product to shape the roadmap.

You will thrive here if you have

  • Experience selling software, SaaS or technical solutions to business buyers.
  • The ability to run a credible technical conversation about integrations, CRM and systems implementation, data migration and user adoption.
  • A structured approach to discovery, qualification and deal control in a high-velocity environment.
  • Curiosity about product and a track record of onboarding customers successfully, not just closing them.

We offer a competitive package, hybrid working from our London office, and a team that ships quickly and reviews each other's work carefully.
